summary.text: Yahu Blackwell is the Republican candidate for Maryland State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Carl Jackson (D) is also running.
A business owner, he advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Blackwell described himself as a heavyweight boxing champion, local business owner and Civil War descendant.
He listed his policy interests as education reform, public safety, taxation, protecting veterans, mental health and homelessness, ending property taxes for homeowners, and making Maryland affordable.
